Summarise gene-expression dynamics along replication progress

Source: R/gex_tempo.R
gex_tempo.Rd

Cells with finite progress are first ordered by increasing replication progress. They are then grouped either into consecutive groups of ncells cells or into nbin_rep equal-width progress intervals. Within each non-empty group, method = "sc2p" applies SC2P_gene_unit() with warnings suppressed and returns Phase I ratios and Phase II means. Alternatively, method = "cp10k" normalises the entire matrix once by each cell's total counts across all input genes and multiplies by 10,000. It then takes the arithmetic mean across cells in each replication bin, including zero gene expression. No log transformation or phase selection is applied. Supply the full gene count matrix before selecting genes for downstream analysis so library sizes reflect all genes. Sparse input remains sparse during normalisation.

Usage

gex_tempo(
  gex_matrix,
  meta_data,
  var_use = "rep_percent",
  ncells = NULL,
  nbin_rep = NULL,
  yy_thres = 15,
  method = c("sc2p", "cp10k")
)

Arguments

gex_matrix

Numeric matrix, data.frame, or Matrix-like object with genes (gene_id) in rows and cells (cell_id) in columns. Values must be finite, non-negative integer counts. Row and column names must be unique.

meta_data

Required data.frame with unique cell IDs as row names, containing every matrix cell and the replication-progress column.

var_use

Column of meta_data containing 0–1 replication progress. Defaults to "rep_percent".

ncells

Optional positive integer giving the number of consecutive progress-sorted cells per group. The final smaller group is retained.

nbin_rep

Optional positive integer giving the number of equal-width replication-progress intervals. Empty intervals are retained as NA columns. ncells and nbin_rep are mutually exclusive. If no grouping parameter is supplied, each cell forms its own group.

yy_thres

Count threshold passed to SC2P_gene_unit(); ignored for cp10k.

method

Either "sc2p" (default) or "cp10k".

Value

For sc2p, a named list with df_phase_I and df_phase_II. Both are data frames with genes in rows and replication bins in columns. The list has rep_bins, cell_info, progress_source, and grouping attributes. In non-empty bins, genes with all-zero counts have Phase I ratio 1 and Phase II mean NA. Empty bins retain NA for both summaries. For cp10k, a list containing df_cp10k_mean, a gene-by-bin data.frame, with the same grouping and cell metadata plus a method attribute. Zero-library cells are excluded from CP10K means; bins with no positive libraries retain NA. Otherwise all-zero genes have mean 0. The cp10k rep_bins attribute also includes n_cells_used, the mean denominator. All input counts are validated for cp10k, including cells with NA progress. SC2P is not run when method = "cp10k".

Details

Replication progress is read only from meta_data[[var_use]], matched by metadata row names to matrix column names. Values must be in 0–1, as in rep_tempo(). Cells with NA/NaN progress are excluded; missing metadata cell IDs, infinite/out-of-range progress, or no usable progress cause an error. Matrix attributes and column ranks are never used as progress.

Examples

set.seed(1)
counts <- matrix(rpois(30 * 40, 2), nrow = 30,
                 dimnames = list(paste0("g", 1:30), paste0("c", 1:40)))
meta <- data.frame(rep_percent = runif(40), row.names = colnames(counts))
res <- gex_tempo(counts, meta, ncells = 10, method = "cp10k")
dim(res$df_cp10k_mean)
#> [1] 30  4
attr(res, "rep_bins")
#>        rep_bin rep_percent   rep_min  rep_max n_cells n_cells_used
#> 1 rep_bin_0001    9.129881  1.854641 28.08001      10           10
#> 2 rep_bin_0002   37.614283 31.423464 44.56445      10           10
#> 3 rep_bin_0003   62.450985 46.938107 70.61567      10           10
#> 4 rep_bin_0004   87.315584 73.617154 99.62718      10           10
